text:
Nina: Who's up for the 'no-elevator' challenge this week? Lobby to 7th and back during lunch. Stairs only. :stairs: 
Omar: Count me in. My calves will hate you but my legs will thank you. :laughing: 
Jules: Is there a prize? Asking for motivational purposes. :cup_with_straw: 
Tara: Winner gets the last of the artisan cookies in the kitchen. Severe motivation. :cookie: 
ben-bot: Reminder: stairs challenge is optional. Please stretch and opt out if you have any injuries.
Ethan: Also I propose an add-on: do 3 pull-ups at the 4th-floor landing. Fail = carry mailbag for a day. :muscle: 
Nina: Love it. 12:10 meet by the mailroom. We time starters with our phones. Fastest round-trip wins. 
Omar: ETA: I might be 2 mins late, sprinting from client call.
Jules: Bringing a GoPro for cinematic ascent. No one asked but it's happening. :camera_with_flash: 
Tara: @Ethan you better not make me do pull-ups, my upper body's asleep. I'll trade you cookie duties.
Ethan: Deal. If I lose, I'll bake granola bars instead of making you carry mail.
ben-bot: Event created: "Stair Sprint Lunchtime" tomorrow 12:10. Optional.
Nina: Ok final q: run or walk down? Downhill is faster but stairs <-> lobby squeezes make it messy. 
Omar: Jog down, but control your knee. Safety first.
Jules: Speaking of safety, remind me where the landing lights are. Last time one was out and it felt like a cliff.
Tara: 3rd-floor landing has the dim bulb. Facilities said they're replacing it on Thursday.
Nina: Alright see you all. May the best calf win. :trophy:
